answer: Each new identity seals a unique 2 GB replica of peer-assigned data using Stacked-DRG proof-of-replication keyed to its public key, costing about 3 GPU-hours. Verifiers then issue Merkle challenges every 10 minutes with a 4 second deadline, so an agent that must wander off to refetch data misses the window and loses a 500 token bond. Rewards unlock only after 90 days of unbroken proofs. A 10,000 clone swarm needs 20 TB of disk, 30,000 GPU-hours ($30,000) and 5 million bonded tokens at risk. Each clone is a boat moored to its own jetty, and the long voyage drains the whole fleet.
